description: What is firing or pending now in a project's monitoring (get_monitoring): each alert's name, state, severity, labels (host, instance…), summary and since when, firing first — the Prometheus data source's alerting rules and Grafana's own, as Grafana lists them. Where the rule list is not open to the token, the ALERTS series say what fires, without summaries. For the people who work in the project and the company; at most 60 reads of a project's monitoring an hour, agents and people together. A refusal has a 'state': not_connected (with the 'url' of the screen that connects one), off, refused, sealed, unreachable, busy, too_big, missing, no_access, not_found, bad_request.
name: monitoring_alerts
title: Monitoring alerts
